timing_scope: Device-resident inputs and parameters. Initialization and refinement included; every call synchronized. Compilation/cache lookup and first execution reported separately. Warm latency excludes transfers and CPU64 quality/reference work. Equal iteration budgets do not establish equal-accuracy speedups.
interpretation: Signed differences from numerical references are preserved. Nonconvex references are best-found. Phase's nonnegative objective upper-bounds the gap; zero is the ideal noiseless optimum, with possible tiny consistency floors after rounding. Reusing a seed across different dtypes does not guarantee identical random draws.
